description: This file defines the Entity Framework Core DbContext for the calendar backend project. It configures the database schema mappings for CalendarEvent, NotificationOutboxItem, and SchedulerStateItem entities, setting up table names, keys, properties, and indexes.

classes.name: AppDbContext
classes.description: The Entity Framework Core DbContext managing database access for calendar events, notifications, and scheduler state.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Overrides the method to configure entity-to-table mappings, keys, properties, and indexes for the database schema.
